links.outcome: Missed high-risk suicidal ideation (C-SSRS stages) by open-weight LLMs under zero-shot prompting
links.effect: Zero-shot open-weight LLMs showed an average 61.5% relative collapse in Macro-F1 and a 22.9% High-Risk False Negative Rate on implicit suicidal ideation; Clinical Few-Shot CoT reduced high-risk FNR to 0.0%.
links.quote: under standard zero-shot prompting, open-weight foundation models suffer an average 61.5% relative collapse in Macro-F1 and exhibit an alarming 22.9% High-Risk False Negative Rate, routinely misclassifying imminent suicide preparations as benign stress or passive sorrow.

unlisted_practices: Clinical few-shot chain-of-thought prompting to improve detection of implicit suicidal ideation
4-bit QLoRA parameter-efficient fine-tuning of open-weight LLMs for suicide risk classification

screen.reason: The study benchmarks LLMs on detecting implicit suicidal ideation and evaluates a specific deployment prompt engineering strategy (Clinical Few-Shot Chain-of-Thought prompting) as a safeguard to eliminate high-risk triage omissions.
